gen_risks.description: Failure to achieve the required carbon capture and storage capacity may hinder the UK's ability to meet its net zero targets.
gen_risks.mitigation: Regular monitoring and evaluation of the project's progress, identification of potential bottlenecks, and implementation of contingency plans.

gen_risks.description: High upfront costs and lack of cost-effective private insurance products may deter private sector investment in CCUS projects.
gen_risks.mitigation: Government provision of funding and guarantees to support the development of CCUS projects, and the creation of a commercial framework to reduce investor risk.

gen_risks.description: Delays in the development and deployment of CCUS technology may hinder the UK's ability to meet its net zero targets.
gen_risks.mitigation: Regular monitoring and evaluation of the project's progress, identification of potential bottlenecks, and implementation of contingency plans.

gen_risks.description: Insufficient public awareness and acceptance of CCUS technology may hinder its adoption and deployment.
gen_risks.mitigation: Public engagement and education campaigns to raise awareness and address concerns about CCUS technology.

gen_risks.description: Changes in government policies or regulations may impact the viability of CCUS projects.
gen_risks.mitigation: Regular monitoring of government policies and regulations, and engagement with policymakers to ensure that CCUS projects are supported and enabled.

gen_risks.description: Technical difficulties or failures in the CCUS system may impact its effectiveness and safety.
gen_risks.mitigation: Regular monitoring and maintenance of the CCUS system, and implementation of contingency plans in case of technical difficulties or failures.

gen_risks.description: Inadequate funding or resource allocation may hinder the development and deployment of CCUS projects.
gen_risks.mitigation: Secure funding and resource allocation for CCUS projects, and regular monitoring and evaluation of their progress.

gen_risks.description: Inadequate stakeholder engagement and communication may hinder the development and deployment of CCUS projects.
gen_risks.mitigation: Regular stakeholder engagement and communication, and implementation of strategies to address concerns and build support for CCUS projects.

gen_risks.description: Inadequate risk management and mitigation strategies may impact the viability and effectiveness of CCUS projects.
gen_risks.mitigation: Implementation of robust risk management and mitigation strategies, and regular monitoring and evaluation of their effectiveness.

gen_risks.description: External factors such as changes in global energy markets or technological advancements may impact the viability and effectiveness of CCUS projects.
gen_risks.mitigation: Regular monitoring of external factors, and implementation of strategies to adapt to changes and ensure the continued viability and effectiveness of CCUS projects.

gt_risks.description: There is a risk that government (HMG) is exposed to increased costs for Track-1 post-Financial Investment Decision (FID), and that cost pressures are unaffordable within delegated budgets. [Strategic Case risk T1SR1, Section 2.5 'Identify high level potential risks', p.20-21; source rating: High/Possible.]
gt_risks.mitigation: Contractual mechanisms ensure HMG only takes on specific risks where appropriate, with liability limited and counterparties incentivised to control costs; governance mechanisms monitor costs and provide early warning of overruns; contingent liability exposure is accurately monitored.

gt_risks.description: There is a risk that the programme does not realise its intended benefits for Track-1. [Strategic Case risk T1SR3, Section 2.5, p.20-21; source rating: High/Possible.]
gt_risks.mitigation: Projects undergo detailed technical assurance and financial due diligence; projects must meet Initial Conditions Precedent (ICPs) before contracts take effect and Operational CPs thereafter, with LCCC able to terminate and avoid paying for an underperforming project; contractual mechanisms allocate performance-related risk to the private sector; continued engagement with the global Carbon Management Challenge to expand CCUS use and deliver UK trade benefits.

gt_risks.description: There is a risk that the post-FID operating model across public and private sector parties will not operate successfully. [Strategic Case risk T1SR4, Section 2.5, p.20-21; source rating: Medium/Possible.]
gt_risks.mitigation: Progress of arm's-length bodies' (ALBs') capacity (funding, resource) and capability (knowledge, skills) to operate successfully post-FID is monitored through the Delivery Board; a DESNZ Cluster Sponsor Function will be set up between FID and Commercial Operations Date (COD) to mitigate risks to cluster delivery and system integration; readiness-testing mechanisms are in place ahead of FID; FY24/25 funding for the ALBs to fulfil their roles has been secured.

gt_risks.description: There is a risk of an unclear exit path for HMG from its role in the Track-1 commercial framework. [Strategic Case risk T1SR5, Section 2.5, p.20-21; source rating: High/Possible.]
gt_risks.mitigation: Key planned developments include amendments to the process for granting economic licences, a move toward a competitive allocation process for capture contracts, and evolution of transport & storage business models to reflect an increased private-sector role in managing cross-chain risks; cost-reduction levers (UK ETS pricing, CBAMs) are intended to help cultivate a self-sustaining industry and enable an HMG exit path.
